summary: Tested Adaptive Game Decryption V5 feature for chess coaching app. All backend API tests (15/15) and frontend UI tests passed. The V5 decryption endpoint correctly implements adaptive priority filtering based on player rating (~1147), filtering inaccuracies (30-99 cp_loss) as silent/good while marking mistakes and blunders as essential. Coach Insight Panel with 3 tabs (Summary, Habits, Memory) working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: _get_adaptive_config() correctly fetches player rating from player_profiles and weaknesses from player_identities
Backend: For rating < 1200, min_cp_explain=100 correctly filters inaccuracies (30-99 cp_loss) as silent
Backend: Mistakes (100-249 cp_loss) and blunders (250+ cp_loss) correctly have priority='essential'
Backend: Opponent moves correctly have priority='context' or 'essential' for blunders
Backend: compute_game_habits() uses 100cp threshold for opening mistakes, so 65cp inaccuracy passes
Frontend: Coach view toggle (data-testid='coach-view-btn') switches between Coach and Decrypt views
Frontend: CoachInsightPanel renders 3 tabs with correct data-testid attributes
Frontend: Memory tab shows Chess DNA (before/after lines, archetype) and impact projection (1147 -> ~1347)
Frontend: Habits tab shows 5 habits with pass/fail status (2/5 passed for test game)
